LLM auditresponse for vexa-export-tfmt-symbols.patch:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This patch modifies a build script (vexa-dynamic.lua) for the Vexa project's xmake build system. The change adds a target configuration for the "tiny-fmt" dependency to set its symbol visibility to "none" (i.e., don't hide symbols), with a comment explaining that tiny-fmt is statically linked and its API is exposed inline in public headers, requiring exported symbols for consumers to link correctly. This is a routine build system adjustment for proper symbol visibility in a C++ shared library context. There are no network operations, file manipulations outside the build, obfuscation, or execution of arbitrary code. The patch is consistent with standard packaging and build practices.
</details>
